revised_sections.heading: ## 共享工作区的调度规则

findings.accepted_direction: Require exclusive nonignored/tracked tree publication window during any gate; ignored orchestration or read-only source preparation may continue. Include tracked ignored files because gate binding explicitly includes all cached paths.

revised_sections.heading: ### 译文修复合并单独处理

findings.accepted_direction: Separate gate-only worktree workers from translation patch integration. Design exact task/baseline/current-evidence synchronization and receipt/native/environment/root validation before enabling parallel gates. Keep export/import/publication in one authoritative root with one lock; retain wave nonempty apply as a separate future limitation. A receipt-copy experiment alone proves no cross-root production acceptance.

Measure command-level export and separate historical-check wall times before maintenance investment. Larger coherent batches can amortize fixed per-task overhead. Do not claim all262seconds are replay, do not claim model-only parallelism provides2x.
findings.qualification: The approximate1.3x bound is illustrative under assumed serial costs, not an observed throughput bound; the mtime interval may include waiting/other work and gate/test time is not proven invariant for all workloads.

findings.accepted_direction: Define baseline and timing start at batch preparation before export, ending at scoped commit. Include every necessary validation/retry. Compare source/risk/text-size/A-B mix and control batching versus scheduling/tool changes separately. Treat2x as a pilot target pending measurement.

root_advisories_addressed.resolution: Three active reviewer children is a conservative scheduling budget, not an established Paseo daemon limit.
Same invocation only; authoritative round_lock, sealed-history reuse, live obligation updates, per-task validation and final full replay.
